flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 3 -> 4 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 4 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 1 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Negative news impacting dollars is being heard, but positive growth is expected based on rolled-out products and services.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "As you know, we have been hearing a lot of news coming out, which are negatively impacting dollars. Having said that, we are seeing positive growth based on the services and products that we are rolling out, and expect this to be a strong financial year." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The international business was relatively flat in YoY comparison, and dollar appreciation had a reciprocal impact on revenues.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In terms of the YoY comparison, our international business was relatively flat. The appreciation in dollar is having the reciprocal impact as far as revenues are concerned, despite about a 6 to 7% appreciation over the last six-seven months." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Management noted that API ecosystems for quick commerce platforms like Blinkit and Zomato are limited to their own platforms.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The other part is the Blinkit, Zomato of the world, doesn't have a correct API." (concall transcript - 2025-10-01)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
Historically weak quarters (Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.
